name: Kashiwagi Rin
source:
The last child at Harmonica Nursery School, which is facing financial difficulties. She loves Harmonica Nursery School and is a lively, determined child who can come to school all by herself.

"Yeah! Because today's the pool day! Rin loves the pool!"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916184540/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/feralym/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
